title: Workspace and boards in a call

Main.dc.html.title: The call, one moment at a time (click around)

end-title.text: The call’s workspace and board, open to everyone in it

what-changes.text:
What changes

• Everyone in the call can open the call’s workspace and its board, and edit them, guests too. It lasts while they’re in the call.
• The frame’s bar says both things: “Only on your screen” (nobody follows you) and “Everyone in the call can edit”. A guest’s says “You can edit while you’re in the call”.
• One menu, on the workspace’s name: Switch workspace, Find, Who’s in it, Rename, Copy link. The list stops repeating it.
• What you make during the call goes in This call, beside its notes, not one level up.
• Switching to another workspace, or opening a board from one, says who it opens to, once, before it does.

What goes away
• “This call’s workspace is private · Ask Art”
• “A board you can’t open”, and “Kofi can’t open it · Let them in for this call”
• A guest’s greyed-out Workspace button
• “Open just for you”, which read like who can open it

my-calls.text:
Calls I made (say if you want them different)

• A document someone closed to some people stays closed.
• A breakout room’s board stays with its room.
• Someone waiting in the lobby gets nothing until they’re let in.
• When a guest leaves, or the call ends, it closes for them at once. What they wrote stays.
• People invited to the call stay in its workspace afterwards, as today.
• Only the organizer switches the workspace. A guest can’t share anything on or copy a link.
